characters.name: friend who was a specialist in sympathy

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes the cloistered technological orthodoxy of Vashti's world and introduces the central conflict through Kuno's heretical desire for direct physical experience.

char_kuno.goal: visit the surface of the earth

required_beats: Vashti isolates her room to answer a call from Kuno.
Kuno insists that Vashti visit him in person outside the mediation of the Machine.
Vashti rejects travel and nature, condemning Kuno's interest in the stars and the surface as contrary to the Machine.
Kuno breaks the connection, leaving Vashti to restore her room's standard communications.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Demonstrates the detached, mediated routine of intellectual and social life inside the Machine.
required_beats: Vashti delivers a lecture on music to an unseen audience.
Vashti joins her audience in listening to a remote lecture about the sea.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Forces Vashti to overcome her dread of physical transit and leave her self-contained cell after Kuno's cryptic refusal to explain himself remotely.
required_beats: Vashti completes her domestic routines and consults the Book of the Machine for air-ship schedules.
Vashti calls Kuno, but he refuses to communicate visually or explain his plans until she visits in person.
Vashti recoils from opening the tunnel wall and attempts to plead illness, only to be treated by the Machine's apparatus.
Kuno hints that something tremendous will happen, refusing to say more over the Machine.
Vashti takes the Book, opens the wall, and steps onto the platform to start her journey.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals the physical distance separating Kuno and Vashti as ordained by the Machine.
required_beats: The Machine assigns Kuno a dwelling on the opposite side of the planet.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict Vashti's agonizing transition from the secluded security of her room into the disturbing reality of physical travel.

obj_air_ships.status: soared above the waters of a tropical ocean

required_beats: Vashti decides to visit Kuno and leaves her room with her Book.
Vashti traverses the platform and boards the crowded air-ship amidst minor mishaps.
As the air-ship emerges over the ocean, the passengers demand artificial light and draw the blinds to block out the natural world.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish the state's total prohibition against competing with or acknowledging nature through the threat of ultimate exile.
required_beats: The Committee of the Machine outlaws racing to defeat the sun on pain of Homelessness.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To highlight the society's extreme aversion to physical touch and its complete disdain for the natural landscape.
required_beats: Vashti's cabin blind flies open, and she summons the attendant when sunlight disturbs her.
The attendant catches Vashti to steady her and is sharply rebuked for violating the taboo against touch.
Upon learning they are over Asia, Vashti demands the Himalayas be hidden because nature offers her no ideas.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reinforce Vashti's persistent rejection of the outside world as her journey continues.
required_beats: Vashti inspects the earth at midday and pulls down the blind to shut out the Caucasus.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Vashti's ongoing aversion to the outside world as she shuts out the sight of Greece.
required_beats: Vashti looks outside in the evening
Vashti conceals Greece behind a metal blind

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Confronts Vashti with Kuno's dire predicament and sets the stakes of his rebellion.
required_beats: Vashti arrives at Kuno's room
Vashti insists she can only stay briefly and urges him to speak
Kuno reveals he is threatened with Homelessness

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals the forbidden transgression that provoked the authorities against Kuno.
required_beats: Kuno ventures up to the surface of the earth after his last talk with Vashti
Kuno's excursion to the outside is discovered

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Exposes the disconnect between technical legality and real danger in the Machine's order.
required_beats: Vashti states that surface visits are legally permitted
Vashti questions why Kuno should not be allowed outside

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Vashti's desperate resistance to Kuno's transgressive desire to reach the surface.
required_beats: Vashti attends a lecture about the sea.
Vashti pleads with Kuno not to travel to the surface.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Confronts Vashti's orthodox submission by revealing Kuno's unauthorized escape method and challenging her devotion to the Machine.
required_beats: Kuno reveals he found his own way to the surface without an Egression-permit.
Vashti insists an independent path is wrong.
Kuno accuses Vashti of worshipping the Machine.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Raises the stakes by showing the severe official punishment hanging over Kuno's insubordination.
required_beats: The Committee threatens Kuno with Homelessness.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Demonstrates Vashti's rigid denial of both religious machine devotion and the possibility of unauthorized escape.
required_beats: Vashti denies worshipping anything.
Vashti insists that no alternative way out of the Machine can exist.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show Kuno's growing restlessness and his physical discovery of an opening in the tunnel system.
required_beats: Kuno paces the platform and calls Vashti, who refuses to come.
Kuno rides the lifts to the topmost platform and explores the railway-tunnels.
Kuno loosens a tile, looks into an opening, and shouts into the darkness.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish the Committee's institutional rejection of Kuno's reproductive request.
required_beats: Kuno applies to become a father.
The Committee denies Kuno's application.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To demonstrate the physical danger of Kuno's transgression and his continued alienation from Vashti.
required_beats: A train brushes past Kuno in the tunnel.
Kuno retreats to the platform, returns to his room, and summons his bed.
Kuno calls Vashti again, but she repeats her refusal.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To register Vashti's horrified resistance to Kuno's forbidden experiences.
required_beats: Vashti implores Kuno to stop speaking of terrible things.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict Kuno's grueling physical ascent through the forgotten ventilation shaft toward the forbidden surface.
required_beats: Kuno prepares his body and uses a respirator to enter the shaft through loosened tiles.
Kuno climbs the rough ladder, injuring his hands as he ascends to the pneumatic stopper.
Guided by inner voices, Kuno leaps and grabs the handle at the stopper's center.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To briefly ground the narrative back in the present conversation before Kuno describes reaching the world above.
required_beats: Kuno pauses his recounting of the journey.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal Kuno's first direct contact with the external world and the mysterious threat waiting above.
required_beats: The stopper blows out onto the surface with Kuno holding on.
Kuno nurses his wounds and catches his breath at the mouth of the shaft before standing in the open hollow.
Kuno attempts to climb the slope but retreats after seeing something grey.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To test Vashti's patience and compel her continued attention despite her ideological aversion to the surface.
required_beats: Kuno expresses regret for summoning Vashti, claiming she cannot find his experience interesting.
Vashti commands Kuno to proceed with the story.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal the forbidden outside world directly through Kuno's eyes.
required_beats: Kuno climbs the bank to look across the open hills.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To build suspense about Kuno's capture while showing Vashti's impatient need to learn the outcome.
required_beats: Kuno halts his narration and attempts to end the conversation.
Vashti repeatedly presses him to explain how he returned underground.
Vashti presents her own mundane guess about his return, which Kuno rejects before resuming the tale.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show the violent retribution of the Machine reclaiming Kuno and murdering his rescuer.
required_beats: Kuno's respirator falls as the fountain fades, prompting him to run down toward the shaft.
White worms emerge from the opening and entrap Kuno's leg.
A woman rushes to aid Kuno but is swiftly killed by a worm.
The worms pull Kuno into the shaft, where he strikes his head and blacks out as the opening seals.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish Kuno's return to the confines of his subterranean cell.
required_beats: Kuno regains consciousness back inside his room.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Concludes Vashti's visit by revealing Kuno's heretical discovery of living humans on the surface before she departs.
required_beats: Vashti prepares to depart and warns Kuno that his defiance will lead to Homelessness.
Kuno welcomes Homelessness and reveals he saw living humans on the surface.
Vashti exits Kuno's room.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Depicts society's further intellectual surrender to the Machine alongside the enforcement of isolation onto Kuno.
required_beats: Terrestrial travel equipment is officially abolished.
A famous lecturer praises the Machine and urges the audience to shun first-hand ideas, gaining wide acclaim.
The speech is enshrined in the Book of the Machine as the Central Committee proclaims new developments.
Kuno is relocated to the southern hemisphere.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Introduces Kuno's prophecy of systemic collapse and demonstrates the populace's inability to comprehend it.
required_beats: Kuno contacts Vashti without video and claims the Machine is stopping, prompting her laughter.
Vashti shares Kuno's claim with a friend, who finds the phrase meaningless.
The friend asks if Kuno means the recent flaws in the music and whether Vashti complained.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Shows the institutional brush-off when citizens report early signs of mechanical degradation.
required_beats: Vashti's complaint is redirected to the Committee of the Mending Apparatus.
The Committee promises that the musical defects will soon be corrected.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish the initial failure of the Machine's repair mechanisms and reveal bureaucratic paralysis.
required_beats: Vashti complains to the Committee of the Mending Apparatus about defective music.
The Committee rebuffs her urgency and explains complaint protocol.
Vashti files an official grievance but is denied information on whether other users are experiencing similar faults.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal that mechanical breakdowns are spreading and complaints are stalling across the network.
required_beats: Vashti discusses her worsening music with a friend.
Vashti's friend describes hearing an anomalous jarring noise.
Vashti's friend confirms that an official complaint was lodged and merely queued.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To show the breakdown escalating to physical necessities and the Machine authorities conceding their own helplessness.
required_beats: Summoned beds fail to appear, prompting widespread complaints.
The Committee admits the Mending Apparatus itself has broken down.
A famous lecturer urges his audience to endure patiently and not press complaints.
Sumatran inhabitants are requested to learn how the central power station functions.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict the ultimate collapse of the global communication network.
required_beats: The worldwide communication system completely breaks down.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To depict the collapse of the Machine and the descent of its inhabitants into total panic.
required_beats: Vashti's communications fail as total silence falls over the network.
Vashti opens her door to see a chaotic mob fighting in the tunnel and retreats inside.
The room collapses around Vashti as she frantically prays and strikes buttons until the door opens again.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To bring Vashti and Kuno together amid the carnage as they acknowledge their fate and reconnect before dying.
required_beats: Vashti searches for Kuno among the dying throngs in the dark tunnel.
Kuno confirms there is no hope for their survival.
Vashti crawls over the dead to reach Kuno, who kisses her and declares they have recaptured life.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To mark a historic historical turning point with the defeat of the Danes.
required_beats: Ælfrid defeats and overthrows the Danes in Wessex.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To plant the final question of humanity's survival on the surface of the Earth.
required_beats: Vashti asks Kuno whether human life persists on the Earth's surface.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Kuno's profound connection with the surviving humans living above ground.
required_beats: Kuno recalls having seen, spoken with, and loved the people living on the surface of the earth.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Brings the total annihilation of the subterranean civilization while affirming that humanity's future survives on the surface.

obj_air_ships.status: soared above the waters of a tropical ocean

required_beats: Kuno tells Vashti that the Homeless are surviving on the surface, waiting for the end of their civilization.
Vashti fears the Machine will be restarted, but Kuno insists humanity has learned its lesson.
A crashing air-ship tears through the galleries, destroying the entire city in catastrophic explosions.
Vashti and Kuno glimpse the untainted sky together in their final moments.
